scientific_integrity: The nonzero Jacobi eigenvalues are established prior results; this claim concerns their three-term power-trace asymptotics. Finite computations corroborate, but do not prove, the infinite limit.
scientific_limitations: The stated O(n^{-1}) is uniform only on compact subsets of the open Jacobi-parameter and positive-power domain.
No simultaneous growing-parameter asymptotic or optimal numeric remainder constant is claimed.
Absolute historical priority is not established; relevant older texts were not all available in full.
title: Three-term Schatten traces for Jacobi Bernstein–Durrmeyer operators
